test_title: PYST 3: SSC JE EE- General Intelligence (Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A & B means ‘A is the wife of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A @ B means ‘A is the Son B’.

A% B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If A & B # C & D @ E % F + G, then how is C related to G?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c4e8c72d6af602247ff139638f300672ffea7450b7a6fc521c017e112b065c4.png]

of B

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression: **'A & B # C & D @ E % F + G'

A is the wife of B, B is the father of C, C is the wife of D, D is the son of E, E is the husband of F and F is the mother of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93050a94b1181e6aaf8e8002d0673e7d5c86c48842be80b27a7978f35611ae3d.png] 

Here, C is the **brother's wife** of G.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
